name: Nightspindle
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs orbital debris ring, stark under a black sky.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
